solution.title: ServiceNow ↔ Microsoft Intune Integration — Device Inventory & CMDB Sync

products.name: ServiceNow ↔ Microsoft Intune Integration — Device Inventory & CMDB Sync — Commercial
products.short_description: Re-establish the CMDB device-inventory feed from Microsoft Intune — the Intune equivalent of your Workspace ONE MDM feed. Read-only Graph, serial-key reconciliation, no duplicate CIs. Do it yourself with self-guided, tested steps — far cheaper than consulting.
products.description:
Your Workspace ONE feed is retiring — keep the CMDB alive with Intune

The moment you move endpoint management from Workspace ONE (AirWatch) to Microsoft Intune, the ServiceNow data feed that keeps your CMDB current goes dark. Incidents lose their device context, ownership goes stale, and duplicate CIs creep in. This solution re-establishes the exact same device-inventory feed — from Intune — so ServiceNow keeps collecting managed devices, ownership, compliance, and installed apps into the CMDB on a schedule, reconciled to one record per device.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a systems integrator to stand this up. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a non-expert administrator can follow across both platforms — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that verify and validate the Microsoft side. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact steps in the right order across the Entra admin center and ServiceNow. Register the read-only app, consent the scopes, connect ServiceNow, map to the CMDB, schedule, validate.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable integration engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with reconciliation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know devices land correctly — and without duplicates — before you retire the Workspace ONE feed.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the data flow (Microsoft Graph → Service Graph Connector → IRE → CMDB) and how it replaces the Workspace ONE feed.
  • Requirements Guide — both platforms: the Microsoft Entra app registration, least-privilege read-only Graph scopes and admin consent, plus the ServiceNow ITOM/connector prerequisites and the serial-number identification rule.
  • Implementation Guide — ordered steps: Entra app & consent → ServiceNow connection → field/CMDB mapping & reconciliation → scheduled import → pilot → validate → expand → retire Workspace ONE.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — preflight, Intune device export, sync/reconciliation comparison, coverage report, and a guarded credential remediation.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy across your whole fleet, and reuse the playbook for the next integration.

The bottom line

A scheduled, reconciled, least-privilege Intune → ServiceNow CMDB device feed that survives the Workspace ONE cutover — keyed on serial number so every device is one trustworthy CI. This package re-establishes the data feed only; the device migration, SAM license workflow, and software entitlement reconciliation are separate solutions.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across your entire fleet — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF & Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run, cloud-aware scripts (read-only by default; remediation is guarded):
    • SNOWINT-Preflight.ps1 — verify the Entra app registration, consented Graph scopes, and managed-device read
    • SNOWINT-Export-ManagedDevices.ps1 — export the exact Intune device dataset ServiceNow imports (for reconciliation)
    • SNOWINT-Validate-Sync.ps1 — compare Intune vs a CMDB export (matched / missing / stale / duplicate serials)
    • SNOWINT-Report-Coverage.ps1 — managed-device coverage by platform, ownership, compliance
    • SNOWINT-Remediation.ps1 — guarded fix for a missing/expired app-registration secret or scope

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts, in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across your fleet.
